title: aidd gate --paths --json
description: The forecast: what `aidd gate --paths --json` prints, and the MCP `gate` tool answers with `paths` (with a `note`): the route of the planned paths and the lane's first step, before any code exists. The same shape holds a branch's change, which the session hooks read: its route, its next steps, and the other branches it overlaps. A forecast records nothing: on the branch, the gate computes the route again from the real diff, and can only raise it.

schema_version.description: The version of this output: a new key keeps it, a renamed or removed one bumps it.

route.description: The route of this change, or null when the branch has no diff and declares no route (or aidd is not set up).

steps.description: The next steps for this change, most urgent first: the Specs this branch changes, or the lane's step when no Spec carries it.

overlaps.description: Other branches whose Specs change the same code (code `overlap`), and a note when only some branches were checked (code `overlap.capped`).

note.description: The MCP tool only: that the answer is a forecast, and the gate decides.

project.description: The config's `project` for the paths forecast: the stack radar and the rules whose `applies` match, must first. Absent when the config has none or there are no paths.

route.description: A route with its lane and why. Further keys may be added in a minor release; a consumer ignores keys it does not know.
The route that applies: the higher of `required` and `declared.route`, as the gate enforces it.

lane.description: The lane the route puts the change on.

reasons.description: Why the diff or the planned paths need `required`, one line each.

header.description: The route in one line, as `aidd gate --paths` prints it first, such as "Route: major (spec lane), set by SPEC-1; the diff alone needs minor".

required.description: The minimum route the diff or the planned paths need, or null when the branch has no diff yet.

by.description: Who declares it: a Spec's id, or `the Change Request block`.

declared.description: The highest route the change declares, in a Spec on the branch or the Change Request block of its newest commit that holds one; null when it declares none.

basis.description: What the route is for: the branch's diff against its base, or the planned paths.

paths.description: The paths the route is for.

dimensions.description: The risk dimensions the paths imply.

pools.description: The specialist Approver pools a major change would need.

changed_lines.description: The branch's changed lines the gate counts against the budget (a diff only).

packs.description: The domain packs the change calls for, wherever its code sits: one per dependency the branch adds to its manifests (a diff only), and one per risk that names a pack (privacy-by-default on the privacy dimension or a `gdpr` compliance target). Absent when none.

dependency.description: The added dependency, as the manifest spells it.

reason.description: The risk that calls for the pack, such as `the privacy dimension`.
